label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — User input from Cookie flows through URL decoding and byte conversion directly to the HTML response sink without effective sanitization at the point of write. The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled. Alerts 2-8 (stack-trace-exposure): alert-TP — Stack traces containing sensitive error info are printed to the HTTP response writer on exception. Alerts 9-10 (weak-crypto): alert-TP — DES algorithm usage is inherently weak regardless of input control. At least one alert-TP confirms case TP.

evidence.note: User-provided value extracted from cookie via URL decode
Decoded user input converted to bytes and written to HTML response without sanitization
Weak cryptographic algorithms (DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding and DES) identified
Stack trace exposure vulnerabilities on multiple exception handlers printing stack traces to response writer
